source.title: 30 Minute Beginner Kettlebell Workout [Full Body Strength Training]

notes: Two sets of 13 moves, 40 s work + 20 s rest, a 60 s rest between the sets (the second set starts at 1105). Work timer in a dashed ring on the floor, rest timer top left; the name only on the NEXT / UP FIRST screens (bottom centre, in a frame that is blurred mid-transition for part of the rest, small then). Warm-up (5 × 30 s) and cool-down (5 × 30 s) names sit in a small NEXT label: top left in the warm-up, bottom left in the cool-down. Expected derived from the countdown (each move starts at its 39 / 29, ±1 s) and read off the NEXT screens by eye.
